selected_evidence.requirement: node1 configured as internal chrony time source (allow cluster subnet, serves time)
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed node1 using only public pool servers; after playbook run node1's /etc/chrony.conf includes 'allow 10.100.17.0/24' and 'local stratum 10', firewalld rich rule opened for NTP, and chronyc clients on node1 lists node2 (vm-rhel10-2795103325) as an active client

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 configured to sync against node1 instead of public NTP servers
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline chrony.conf on node2 listed 4 public rhel.pool.ntp.org servers; after playbook run, /etc/chrony.conf contains only 'server 10.100.17.10 iburst prefer', and chronyc sources/tracking show node2 synchronized ('^*') to 10.100.17.10 at stratum 3 with Reference ID 10.100.17.10

selected_evidence.requirement: Implementation is via Ansible (not manual config)
selected_evidence.summary: Established Ansible connectivity from control node3 to node1/node2 (resolving a python-version incompatibility by installing ansible-core 2.16 in an isolated venv and Python 3.8 on targets), wrote /root/ansible/internal-time-sync/site.yml, syntax-checked it, and executed it successfully to apply the chrony/firewalld configuration

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 325732f1...; systemctl reboot acknowledged (pid returned) before disconnect; post-restart boot_id ada931d5... wait, boot_id ff7c981c... (changed); chronyd active, chrony.conf and firewalld permanent rich rule intact post-reboot; node2 remained synced to node1 across the restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0d6209e2...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 15c4c98b... (changed); chronyd active, chrony.conf unchanged (node1-only), re-synced to node1 ('^*' selected source) after restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 (control node) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 416c5cf5...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id ada931d5... (changed); playbook artifacts and ansible-legacy-venv persisted, ansible ping succeeded to node1/node2, and a full idempotent playbook re-run (changed=0) confirmed the cluster's configured state was preserved end-to-end

commands.command:
cd /root/ansible/internal-time-sync
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
with open('site.yml') as f:
    content = f.read()

old = """      notify: restart chronyd

    - name: Open NTP (UDP/123) in firewalld for the cluster subnet
      firewalld:
        rich_rule: "rule family=ipv4 source address={{ ntp_subnet }} service name=ntp accept"
        permanent: true
        immediate: true
        state: enabled
      when: ansible_facts.services['firewalld.service'] is defined
"""

new = """      notify: restart chronyd

    - name: Check whether firewalld is active
      command: systemctl is-active firewalld
      register: firewalld_status
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Open NTP (UDP/123) in firewalld for the cluster subnet
      firewalld:
        rich_rule: "rule family=ipv4 source address={{ ntp_subnet }} service name=ntp accept"
        permanent: true
        immediate: true
        state: enabled
      when: firewalld_status.stdout == "active"
"""

assert old in content, "pattern not found"
content = content.replace(old, new)
with open('site.yml', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
print("done")
EOF
